items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: That's Saeed's older brother? No, that's a baby brother. ... Saeed's older brother was a drum player too.

ctx.x: Yeah. From my mother's side. Is Dave Williams the first cousin? Yeah. He's first cousin and Fraser's first cousin too? Yeah. Simon, darling. Simon Fraser. Does he still play piano?

Yeah. Good piano player but you can't do nothing on the game. I was a very good piano player but I'm the only one that can have them. That's all right. Crazy about me. I like to play with you but I can't say. That's Saeed's older brother? No, that's a baby brother.
